title: CLO 2025.0 - Virtual Model
description: This video will introduce the functional updates of the virtual model, helping you to edit your virtual model more freely, thereby creating more ideal clothing effects.
transcript:
In this video, I will introduce the functions of the virtual model for you.  
In the 2025 version, we can use the slider to easily adjust the shape of the male and female virtual models.  
To demonstrate this function, we add a female virtual model of FV2.1 and open the virtual model editor.  
In the shape of the virtual model size, you will see a new hip part, which includes two adjustable parameters: waistline and size.  
In the default situation, both are set to 50%.  
You can create various hip shapes by changing these values.  
The way the slider is operated is the same as the operation of adjusting the chest shape.  
It can be easily controlled by dragging the slider.  
You can also make more accurate adjustments by inputting values directly on the right side.  
If you want to reset all the changes to default, you can press the reset button in the upper right corner.  
Turn the view to the back to observe.  
Now let's see how the hip shape changes when adjusting each parameter.  
The first parameter is the waistline.  
The waistline can adjust the natural waistline between the hip and thigh sides.  
Slide the slider to the left to reduce the waistline value.  
Note that when moving the slider for the first time, it may pop up a message window.  
If you choose not to display, the next time you move the slider, the window will not appear.  
Press OK to confirm, then move the slider to the left.  
As the value decreases, you will see that the curve on both sides of the hip is more curved.  
Slide the slider to the right to move the slider, which can fill the volume on both sides of the hip, and thus form a rounder hip shape.  
Next, let's create a flatter or more curved hip by adjusting the second parameter, size.  
Let's turn to the side view to observe.  
You will see that there are two options at the bottom of the slider.  
If you slide the slider to one side, you can create a flatter hip shape.  
Sliding to the other side can increase the size of the upper part of the hip and improve the appearance of the hip.  
This function is also used in male virtual models.  
First, let's add a male virtual model in the MV2.1 version.  
You will find the hip in the same position.  
The type, O-line, and volume parameters are the same as female virtual models due to the same operation process.  
You can directly adjust the value and adjust the hip according to your needs.  
Please note that adjusting these hip parameters will not affect the size, value, or measurement of the hip or lower hip.  
By using the new function in the virtual model editor, you can easily create various hip shapes.  
In the previous version, we had to use third-party software to name each pair of shoes or earrings correctly,  
in order to correctly define the shoes in Colo.  
In the latest version, the customized symmetry configuration has become more convenient.  
Next, we will use shoes as an example.  
First, open a virtual model.  
Then, click on the virtual model in the main menu bar.  
Select the customized configuration.  
In the customized configuration, find the configuration type and select shoes.  
Then you can choose flat shoes or high heels.  
Here, use high heels to demonstrate.  
Next, click on the file plus icon.  
Insert the file containing two shoes at the same time.  
After this update, we also support files with the input OBJ format.  
After the update, Colo can automatically identify each shoe.  
There is no need to name it by left or right.  
In addition, in the new version, you can directly select two shoes.  
Right-click and select shoes.  
You can see that the shoes will be displayed in red.  
It's just the shoes you chose.  
If you set it wrong, you can right-click again and select cancel settings as shoes.  
This step is only applicable to high heels,  
because it needs to automatically raise the virtual model's heel to adapt to the heel when loading.  
Next, we will save the shoes.  
So, next time, you can directly use the saved configuration file.  
I hope these functions can help you optimize the workflow.  
Make the process of customizing the matching configuration more convenient.  
Next, I will introduce you to the 2025.0 version.  
Another workflow that can greatly simplify the process.  
Now you can see that the virtual model currently has a side position.  
In the previous version, if you wanted to do the mirror effect of the current position, you had to modify the position from the beginning.  
But in the new version, you only need to right-click on the virtual model and then select the flip position option.  
This will immediately convert the virtual model into a flipped position.  
And the costume will also be simulated accordingly.  
This function allows you to try various positions and easily flip them.  
Therefore, it is more flexible to test the effect of different angles when simulated.  
In the new version, the virtual model editor also has another important update.  
You can create and edit  
the chest of the female virtual model to be the same size as the cup.  
Let's see how to edit it.  
Open the virtual model editor.  
Under the virtual model size option card,  
in the width, select the chest.  
Now you can set the detailed information.  
Activate the cup size option.  
After activating, you can set the standard size of the chest.  
You can change the number of sizes.  
The smallest value is 3.  
The largest value is 6.  
In addition, you can also change the name and value of each cup size.  
This value indicates the difference between the chest and the lower chest.  
If you want to reset it to default, you can click reset.  
After setting up,  
you can exit the detailed information window.  
Now you can choose the cup size according to the previous size preset.  
Just click the down arrow.  
Select the cup size you want to use.  
The chest cup size will be adjusted accordingly.  
You can see the value just set is displayed at the bottom of the chest size.  
This function can help you create a more standard chest size.  
Make the virtual model chest adjustment process more standardized.  
Use the reset first  
to make a virtual model chest adjustment as usual.

chunks.title: CLO 2025.0 - Virtual Model
chunks.content: ## Virtual Model Shape Adjustment in CLO 2025.0 This section explains the new shape adjustment features for male and female virtual models in CLO 2025.0, including the use of sliders to customize hip shape and chest size with precise parameter controls. ### Hip Shape Adjustment The 2025 version introduces enhanced control over virtual model hip shapes via two adjustable parameters: **waistline** and **size**. - **Waistline** adjusts the natural waist between the hip and thigh. - Sliding left decreases the waistline value, creating a more curved hip profile. - Sliding right increases the waistline, filling volume on both sides for a rounder hip shape. - A confirmation message appears on first use but can be disabled subsequently. - **Size** adjusts the upper hip volume and contour. - Sliding one direction flattens the hip. - Sliding the other increases the upper hip size, improving the hip’s appearance. - Observation from the side view helps visualize these changes. These adjustments work similarly for both **female (FV2.1)** and **male (MV2.1)** virtual models, with hip parameters such as type, O-line, and volume sharing the same operation. **Important:** Changing hip parameters does not affect the overall hip or lower hip size, value, or measurements. ### Operation and Controls - Sliders are controlled by dragging or by inputting exact numerical values. - A reset button restores all shape parameters to default. - The virtual model view can be rotated (e.g., to the back or side) to better observe shape changes. --- ## Customized Symmetry Configuration for Shoes This section details the improved workflow in CLO 2025.0 for configuring symmetrical accessories like shoes using the new customized configuration system. ### Shoe Configuration Workflow - Open a virtual model, then access the **Customized Configuration** from the main menu. - Under configuration type, select **Shoes**, choosing between flat shoes or high heels (demonstrated with high heels). - Use the file plus icon to import shoe files; the system now supports **OBJ format**. - CLO automatically identifies and assigns left and right shoes, eliminating the need to name files manually. - To select shoes, right-click the imported files and choose **Shoes**. Selected shoes highlight in red. - If mistakenly set, right-click again to cancel shoe settings. ### Special Handling for High Heels - The system automatically raises the virtual model’s heel to adapt to high heel height during loading. - Saves configurations so shoes can be quickly reused in future sessions. --- ## Virtual Model Position Flipping This section covers the new function to flip the virtual model’s pose quickly, facilitating flexible angle testing and costume simulation. - Previously, mirroring the model required manual repositioning. - In CLO 2025.0, right-click the virtual model and select **Flip Position**. - This instantly flips the model's pose and adjusts the costume simulation accordingly. - Enables easy experimentation with different perspectives without complex manual edits. --- ## Chest Size Customization by Cup Size This section describes the updated chest size editing feature for female virtual models, allowing standardized adjustments using cup sizes.

chunks.title: CLO 2025.0 - Virtual Model
chunks.content: --- ## Virtual Model Position Flipping This section covers the new function to flip the virtual model’s pose quickly, facilitating flexible angle testing and costume simulation. - Previously, mirroring the model required manual repositioning. - In CLO 2025.0, right-click the virtual model and select **Flip Position**. - This instantly flips the model's pose and adjusts the costume simulation accordingly. - Enables easy experimentation with different perspectives without complex manual edits. --- ## Chest Size Customization by Cup Size This section describes the updated chest size editing feature for female virtual models, allowing standardized adjustments using cup sizes. ### Procedure for Chest Cup Size Adjustment - Open the virtual model editor and navigate to the **Virtual Model Size** tab. - Select **Chest** under width options, then activate the **Cup Size** feature. - Set the chest’s standard size by choosing a cup size number between **3 (smallest)** and **6 (largest)**. - Customize the name and corresponding value for each cup size, representing the difference between chest and underbust measurements. - A reset button restores the default cup size settings. ### Usage - After configuration, exit the detailed information window. - Use the dropdown menu to select the desired cup size preset. - The chest size adjusts accordingly, with the selected cup size value displayed beneath the chest size control. - This feature standardizes the chest modeling process and integrates smoothly with existing adjustments. - Use the reset button first to start with a base virtual model chest before applying new cup size settings. --- # Summary CLO 2025.0 enhances virtual model customization with precise slider controls for hip shape, standardized chest cup size adjustments, improved accessory symmetry configuration (notably for shoes), and a convenient pose flipping feature. These updates streamline workflows, improve realism, and increase flexibility in virtual model editing and simulation.
